meta.title: MERA theme · Diagram Mermaid
meta.description: Applies the MERA persona palette (the Mermaid.js gijinka 'MERA'): raspberry rose #FF3670, pearl white, and ink navy #111827. Light appearance gets the sunny-day wallpaper, dark gets the rainy-night one; surfaces turn translucent so the artwork shows through. Compatible with the Light, Dark, and System appearance choices; turning the plugin off restores the built-in look.
